scripts.dev:server: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.dev:client: cross-env VITE_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm run dev --workspace client
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build --workspace shared && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on tcp:5173 && node scripts/dev-electron.mjs"
scripts.build:local: npm run clean && npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && cross-env VITE_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm run build --workspace client
scripts.build:cloud: npm run clean && npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && cross-env VITE_SERVER_URL=https://xiaoelong.cn npm run build --workspace client
scripts.deepseek:check: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run deepseek:check --workspace server
scripts.question-bank:import: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run question-bank:import --workspace server --
scripts.question-bank:explain: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run question-bank:explain --workspace server --
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build:cloud && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.electron:dist:mac: npm run build:cloud && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never && npm run mac:update-manifest
